invariants.name: invariant_registrySync / property_registrySync
invariants.description: For every candidate strategy: isRegisteredStrategy[s] <=> (s in yieldStrategies[]) <=> (strategyTokens[s] != 0); array holds no duplicates.

invariants.name: invariant_splitConservation / property_splitConservation
invariants.description: Per claim: nudgeAmount + phlimboAmount == actualPayment (no value created/destroyed in the split; phlimbo derived by subtraction).

invariants.name: invariant_globalConservation / property_globalConservation
invariants.description: Aggregate over all claims: total reward pulled from claimers == total received by nudge + total received by phlimbo.

invariants.name: testFuzz_DecimalRoundtrip
invariants.description: denormalize(normalize(x, token), token) <= x for all configured tokens (claimer-favoring floor); exact when exchangeRate in {0, 1e18}.

invariants.name: test_DecimalDrain_UnconfiguredStrategyToken_ZeroPayment
invariants.description: FLAGSHIP HAZARD (CODE-001/ECON-01): registered strategy with a 6-dec UNCONFIGURED token + 6-dec configured reward token => 1000 tokens of real yield delivered to claimer while actualPayment == 0. Demonstrates the drain.

invariants.name: test_ZeroFloor_TinyYield_ConfiguredTokens
invariants.description: Ledger L-01: even with all tokens correctly configured, sub-1-reward-unit yield denormalizes to 0 => claim made for free.

invariants.name: invariant_nftCostExactlyOne / property_nftCostExactlyOne (+ test_NoNFTBurnOnRevert, test_ExactlyOneNFTBurnedOnSuccess)
invariants.description: Exactly 1 ERC1155 unit burned per successful claim; zero burned on any revert (atomic rollback).

invariants.name: invariant_noResidual / property_noResidual
invariants.description: Accumulator strands no reward token and no strategy underlying token after any claim (in == out).
